text: I'm sorry to hear you're experiencing these symptoms. To better understand your condition, can you tell me if your cough produces any mucus, and if so, what color is it? Additionally, have you noticed any triggers like cold air, exercise, or certain environments that make the symptoms worse?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old female. The patient reports a 1-month history of episodic cough and shortness of breath. The cough is nonproductive and worsens when climbing stairs and at night. She experienced fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion 8 weeks ago.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. text: My main symptom is Episodic cough and shortness of breath. I also have Cough worsens with exertion and at night, History of recent upper respiratory tract infection symptoms such as fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion.

text: Past medical history: 10-year history of hypertension, currently managed with enalapril. History of smoking half a pack of cigarettes daily for 16 years. Social history: Smoker, half a pack of cigarettes daily for 16 years.

speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-viral reactive airway dysfunction (post-infectious cough).
